が、食卓にはおかずが丸々残っている。

pages.en:
“——Phew.”

I set down my empty rice bowl with a clack.

But every side dish on the table is still untouched.

Finishing the rice and miso soup took everything I had. I could not spare a thought for the rest of the meal.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Phew.”
I put down the empty bowl.
But the side dishes are still untouched.
It was all I could do to finish the rice and miso soup. I don’t even want to think about eating anything else.

pages.ja:
だが仕方あるまい、許せ桜。
今はとにかく席を立って、部屋で落ち着く時間が欲しいのだ。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
No choice. Sorry, Sakura.

Right now, I just need to get away from the table and calm down in my room.
pages.mirrorMoon:
But it can’t be helped. Forgive me, Sakura.
I want to get away from here and give myself a chance to calm down.

pages.ja:
「…………先輩。あの、今朝のは口に合いませんか？」
「
う」
戦略的撤退、失敗。
俺一人気付いていないだけで、とっくに退路はなかったらしい。

pages.en:
“…Shirou. Um, was this morning's food not to your liking?”

“————Urk.”

Strategic retreat: failed.

Apparently, everyone but me had noticed that my escape route was cut off long ago.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…Senpai. Um, did you not like the breakfast today?”
“Ugh.”
Strategic retreat, failed.
It seems I’m the only one who didn’t notice that there is no escape.

pages.ja:
「………………」
無言でお茶わんを差し出す。
pages.jaRuby:
「………………」
無言でお茶わんを差し出す。
pages.en:
“……”

Without a word, I hold out my rice bowl.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“……”
I hand her the bowl silently.

pages.ja:
「はい、御代わりですね！ いっぱい作りましたから、たくさん食べてください」
……山盛りで返ってくるお茶わんを受け取って、朝食を再開する。
pages.jaRuby:
「はい、御代わりですね！ いっぱい作りましたから、たくさん食べてください」
……山盛りで返ってくるお茶わんを受け取って、朝食を再開する。
pages.en:
“Yes, another helping! I made plenty, so please eat as much as you like.”

…The bowl comes back piled high. I accept it and resume breakfast.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Oh, seconds!? I made a lot, so please eat up.”
…I take the refilled bowl and resume breakfast.

」

一人で顔を赤くしてるのも我慢するし、桜の一挙一動に目がいってしまうのも言い訳しない。

pages.en:
“————”

…No point resisting. I must accept my fate.

Fine. I will sit here blushing like an idiot, and I will not make excuses for the way my eyes follow Sakura's every move.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“”
…I guess it can’t be helped. I’ll prepare myself.
I’ll just have to deal with the fact that I’m blushing, and I won’t make excuses for looking at every move Sakura makes.

pages.ja:
けど、いくらなんでもだな、
「
桜。ちょっと、彼女は問題があるんじゃないのか」

pages.en:
But even accounting for that——

“——Sakura. Isn't there something strange about having her here?”
pages.mirrorMoon:
But still…
“Sakura. Isn’t she a problem?”

pages.ja:
「？ 先輩、問題ってなんですか？」
不思議そうにこっちを見る。
つまり桜は、
こう、隣に無言で座っているライダーを、不思議に思っていないらしい。
pages.jaRuby:
「？ 先輩、問題ってなんですか？」
不思議そうにこっちを見る。
つまり桜は、
こう、隣に無言で座っているライダーを、不思議に思っていないらしい。
pages.en:
“Hm? What do you mean, Shirou?”

She gives me a puzzled look.

In other words, Sakura finds nothing strange about Rider sitting silently beside us.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…? What do you mean by that, Senpai?”
She looks at me in wonder.
In other words…
It seems that the presence of Rider sitting silently next to her doesn’t bother Sakura at all.

pages.ja:
「だから、問題っていうのは」
ちらり、とライダーに視線を送る。
それでこの場での不釣合いさに気付いたのか、
「私に気を払う必要はありません。食事を続けて結構です」
桜に負けない優雅さで、そんなコトを言いやがった。
pages.jaRuby:
「だから、問題っていうのは」

pages.en:
“I mean, the problem is…”

I glance toward Rider.

Perhaps only then does she realize how out of place she is at this table.

“You need not concern yourself with me. Please continue your meal.”

She even has the nerve to say it with an elegance to rival Sakura's own.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Well, by problem…”
I take a look at Rider.
She must have realized she’s out of place.
“You do not need to worry about me. Please go ahead and eat.”
Her elegance is a match for Sakura’s.

pages.ja:
「え？ 先輩、彼女のコトが気になってたんですか？」
「そのようですね。確かに、彼とは何度か争った仲です。
食事の場に仇敵がいては落ち着かないのでしょう」
pages.jaRuby:
「え？ 先輩、彼女のコトが気になってたんですか？」

pages.en:
“What? Was Rider bothering you, Shirou?”

“So it would appear. He and I have crossed blades several times.

“The presence of a mortal enemy at the breakfast table must make it difficult for him to relax.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Huh? Were you feeling uneasy because of her, Senpai?”
“It seems so. We fought several times, after all.
I am sure having your bitter enemy at the table with you is uncomfortable.”

pages.ja:

」

恨んではいないが、Ａ＋がつくほど苦手な部類なんだ、桜。

“That isn't true. Shirou doesn't hold a grudge against you, Rider.”

“————”

…This is difficult.

I do not hate her, but when it comes to people I cannot handle, Rider ranks a solid A+, Sakura.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“That’s not true. Senpai doesn’t hold a grudge against you.”
“”
…This is troubling.
I don’t have a grudge against her, but she has a rank of A+ in terms of people I cannot get along with.

pages.ja:
「……どうでしょうか。
彼の食事が進まないのは私がいるからのようです。目に付くというのなら席を外しますが」
「だから、そんなコトないですっ。ね、先輩はライダーがいてもかまいませんよね？」
pages.jaRuby:
「……どうでしょうか。
彼の食事が進まないのは私がいるからのようです。目に付くというのなら席を外しますが」
「だから、そんなコトないですっ。ね、先輩はライダーがいてもかまいませんよね？」
pages.en:
“…I wonder.

“My presence does seem to be preventing him from eating. If it bothers him to have me here, I will withdraw.”

“That's not it! Shirou, you don't mind Rider being here, do you?”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…What shall I do?
It seems he is not eating much because of me. I can leave if I am annoying him.”
“I’m saying that’s not true! You don’t mind even if Rider’s here, right, Senpai?”
